validator.source_text:
<?ui-args --schema urn:example:ext=tests/ui/schemas/extension.xsd?>
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" xmlns:x="urn:example:ext" initial="a">
  <state id="a">
    <transition event="go" target="done"/>
  </state>
  <final id="done">
    <donedata><x:note>reviewed</x:note></donedata>
  </final>
</scxml>

notes: the W3C SCXML 1.0 schema rejects this under XML Schema constraint `cvc-complex-type.2.4`: Element 'note' is not allowed at this position in the content model
diagnostics.help: `<donedata>` accepts `<content>`, `<param>` (each within its schema cardinality and order)
spec_references: XML Schema 1.0 Part 1 §3.4.4 Element Locally Valid (Complex Type) (`cvc-complex-type.2.4`)
